caption: The video captures a round wall clock with a black rim and reversed-order numerals mounted on a pale textured wall, while a heap of glossy multicolored Christmas-light bulbs rests still on a cream woven surface in the foreground. A short black hand holds nearly still near the top of the dial, between the 11 and 12 positions. The long black hand rotates steadily throughout the excerpt, sweeping down from the 8 mark past 7 and 6 toward the 4 mark. A thin red hand alternates its orientation from frame to frame, pointing toward the right side on some samples and toward the left on others, producing a rapid left-right flicker. The framing of the clock and the pile of bulbs stays fixed, indicating a stationary camera. The bulbs remain in place. The wall and clock face remain unchanged apart from the moving hands.
